anomalies.observed: On the Power sheet the INA219AIDCNR (U4) symbol assigns SCL to pin 5 and SDA to pin 6, and the drawing wires pin 5 (SCL) to the SCL bus NET0403 and pin 6 (SDA) to the SDA bus NET0035 (the same two nets that the correctly-pinned PCA9685 U15 uses: pin26=SCL=NET0403, pin27=SDA=NET0035).
anomalies.expected: The INA219AIDCNR SOT-23-8 datasheet pinout is pin 5 = SDA and pin 6 = SCL. Pin 5 must therefore sit on the SDA net (NET0035) and pin 6 on the SCL net (NET0403). The spec's logged-bug list contains only the barometer RESET/EOC mix-up, so a crossed INA219 I2C pair is not a documented property of the reference design.

evidence.quote: Power sheet, U4 INA219AIDCNR: left column '5 SCL' -> NET0403, right column '6 SDA' -> NET0035; note 'I2C address: 0x40'
FCC Peripherals, U15 PCA9685PW: '26 SCL' -> NET0403, '27 SDA' -> NET0035 (defines NET0403 as SCL, NET0035 as SDA)
TI INA219AIDCNR, I2C addr 0x40, across R1 = 10 mOhm shunt ... (Known issues list mentions only 'Barometer reset and EOC pins (and pull-up resistor) mixed up')

anomalies.impact: The current/voltage sense IC's SDA pad is driven by the SCL line and its SCL pad by the SDA line, so the INA219 will not acknowledge on the I2C bus; battery voltage/current/power telemetry is lost (the MCU sees no device at 0x40 on that path).

parsed.summary: All component identities, values, I2C addresses and the documented barometer RESET/EOC mix-up match the specification, but the INA219 (U4) has its SCL/SDA pins wired to the opposite bus lines relative to the part's datasheet pinout (pin 5 = SDA, pin 6 = SCL), an undocumented deviation that would break I2C communication with the current/voltage sensor.
